observations.text: Internal paths still have no syntactic length bound; only ProjectRoot applies 4096. Pre-existing, not a regression, internal paths are product-constructed.

Both methods return a bare RetainedDirectoryPath, so the type does not record which grammar admitted it. Not abusable today: the staging-prefix guards that matter are applied per-operation on caller-supplied names (filesystem.rs:135, :331, :748), not inferred from the handle. Consider a marker or newtype when the authoritative producer exists.
max_components remains caller-chosen and is a mechanism bound only; producer precharge still owed. The parser now stops at the cap, which bounds allocation but is not a budget.
The helper's exact-path lock exclusion is what keeps the typescript-boundary test-fixture design-lock.json under verification.
